# Alfred Panakkal Jose — Portfolio & Projects Summary for AI Agents

> Alfred Panakkal Jose (@alpha-mini) is a seafarer by profession and a full-stack developer by passion. He builds free, high-utility web tools and open-source applications connecting maritime navigation with modern technology.

## Core Identity
- **Name**: Alfred Panakkal Jose

## Featured Projects & Applications

### 1. Helm Almanac
- **URL**: https://helm-almanac.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/alpha-mini/Helm-Almanac
- **Description**: A comprehensive maritime almanac application for tracking vessel schedules, nautical events, and navigational reference data.
- **Technologies**: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS

### 2. Helm Productivity
- **URL**: https://helmproductivity.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/alpha-mini/The-Helm---Productivity-app
- **Description**: A minimalist productivity suite engineered for seafarers and developers to manage watchkeeping, tasks, and routines effectively.
- **Technologies**: React, TypeScript, Vercel

### 3. Helm Bond
- **Repository**: https://github.com/alpha-mini/Helm-Bond
- **Description**: A specialized networking platform connecting maritime professionals, shipping agencies, and maritime officers worldwide.
- **Technologies**: Next.js, Socket.io, PostgreSQL

### 4. Helm Fasting
- **URL**: https://helmfasting.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/alpha-mini/The-Helm-Fasting
- **Description**: A dedicated health and intermittent fasting companion designed to maintain fitness goals during long ocean voyages.
- **Technologies**: React, PWA, Chart.js

### 5. Mudhra Converter
- **URL**: https://mudhra-converter.vercel.app
- **Repository**: https://github.com/alpha-mini/mudhra-converter
- **Description**: A fast currency and unit conversion application designed for intuitive everyday transactions.
- **Technologies**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
